enterprises.name: Elite Fin Group fisheries
enterprises.description: Elite Fin Group fisheries is focused on profitable catfish production with a clear and realistic financial plan, we combine sound aquaculture practices with disciplined financial management.

enterprises.name: Aqua_Drift
enterprises.description: It's an aquaculture business that deals on catfish farming, production, distribution and preservation hub. We connect other catfish farmers, create market for them to connect with consumers.

enterprises.name: WEALTHSTREAM FISHRIES
enterprises.description: WealthStream Fisheries is a sustainable fish farming business producing and supplying fresh, high-quality fish to homes, markets, restaurants, and businesses.

enterprises.name: AGRO FUSION LTD
enterprises.description: Agro Fusion Ltd is an innovative, partnership-driven agribusiness that integrates sustainable aquaculture with renewable energy solutions. Based in Calabar Metropolis, Cross River State, the company specializes in the production, processing, and distribution of premium fresh and smoked catfish while serving markets across Cross River State and beyond.

enterprises.name: AquaFeed Production
enterprises.description: Aqua Feed is a Nigerian agribusiness focused on producing high-quality, locally formulated fish feed for fish farmers across the country. Based in Cross River State, we manufacture affordable floating and sinking catfish feed using locally sourced raw materials to reduce production costs and improve accessibility for farmers.

enterprises.name: Aqua Wonder
enterprises.description: We produce high-performance, alternative protein fish feed by transforming organic waste into high-value inputs

enterprises.name: AgriNourisha Ltd
enterprises.description: AgriNuorisha Ltd is an innovative agribusiness startup operating within the circular bio economy. We specialize in fish feed formulation and production. Our mission is to produce high quality, affordable and scientifically optimized nutrient rich feed for fish farmers across South East Nigeria by upcycling organic waste such as rice husks and utilizing Black Soldier Fly (BSF) larvae as a low cost and sustainable protein source.

enterprises.name: HerVestia Agro Ltd
enterprises.description: HerVerstia Agro Limited is an agribusiness providing affordable, solar-powered rice threshing services to smallholder farmers in Enugu State, Nigeria. The business is establishing three service clusters in Adani, Uzo-Uwani LGA; Oduma, Aninri LGA; and Nkerefi, Nkanu East LGA, where rice production is active but access to mechanised post-harvest services remains limited.

enterprises.name: Sammuv greengraze farm
enterprises.description: Sammuv Greengraze Farm is an agribusiness using integrated farming systems that combine crop production and aquaculture to produce quality food sustainably, improve productivity, and create jobs.

enterprises.name: Albarka fish processing
enterprises.description: Albarka Fish Processing is a value-added agribusiness specializing in the production of high-quality smoked and dried fish. We process fresh fish into safe, nutritious,and package it

enterprises.name: Arewa Fish Growers
enterprises.description: Arewa Fish Growers processes premium smoked catfish sourced from local farmers. We provide hygienic processing, quality packaging, and reliable fish products for customers in Kano.

enterprises.name: PRO-RICE GROWER
enterprises.description: Pro-Rice Growers transform broken rice into high-protein source of a sustainable fish feed using solid-state fermentation (SSF).

enterprises.name: Egodinula Farms and General Enterprises
enterprises.description: We are catfish farmers and vegetable(green) and grains(rice, corn and beans) farmer located in Kano State Nigeria. We use solar powered system for water. We also provide local farmers our nutrient rich catfish waste water for irrigation farming.

enterprises.name: Bilaady General Enterprise
enterprises.description: Bilaady General Enterprise is an integrated agro-business focused on rice production and processing, poultry farming, and food services. It addresses the challenges of poor-quality food processing, limited access to affordable protein, and inconsistent food supply. Our solution is to provide hygienic, well-processed rice, quality poultry products, and reliable food services through improved techniques and efficient distribution.

enterprises.name: Golden Grain Rice Processing Enterprise
enterprises.description: GoldenGrain transforms locally sourced rice into premium rice flour and valuable by-products, reducing waste, promoting sustainability, and improving food security through value-added processing.

enterprises.name: Aqualife Farms
enterprises.description: Aqaulife-Farms producing table-sized fish (1.5kg) per 4-6months cycle. Sell to restaurants and processors and households. Focus on fish production. No processing beyond farming.

enterprises.name: Green Coal Initiative
enterprises.description: Green Coal Initiative is an innovative social business venture in Niger State that converts leftover, discarded rice husks into affordable, high-efficiency cooking fuel. Currently, many rural families and small businesses face skyrocketing fuel costs alongside a severe shortage of traditional firewood. By strategically placing our production machines right next to local rice mills, we secure a constant supply of raw materials and completely eliminate expensive transportation costs.

enterprises.name: Fish processing/packaging
enterprises.description: We buy fresh fish directly from fish pond owners, process it using industrial hydrates and package ir for retail and bulk sale.

enterprises.name: Paddy Guide
enterprises.description: In Northern Nigeria, where 72% of our rice is grown, over 8 million farmers are farming in uncertainty, guessing when to plant, how much fertilizer to use, and how to fight pests and disease. In Niger State, our top producer, over a million farmers are one bad decision away from loss.

enterprises.name: VISIONARY AGRIBUSINESS LTD
enterprises.description: We produce and sell premium deboned, spiced, oven-dried catfish in 200g, 500g, and 1kg packs targeting health-conscious Ogun households, students, and export markets.

enterprises.name: AgroAqua Innovators
enterprises.description: Ogun-based AgroAqua Innovators produces premium, deboned dried catfish fillets infused with traditional Nigerian spices to offer a convenient, ready-to-eat product.

enterprises.name: AquaHatch Initiative
enterprises.description: AquaHatch Initiative is an aquaculture enterprise dedicated to breeding and supplying healthy, high quality catfish fingerlings and juveniles to fish farmers. We address the challenge of poor quality fish stock and high mortality during transportation by producing robust fingerlings and delivering them in oxygenated transport bags to ensure they arrive healthy and ready for stocking.

enterprises.name: Rivers Aqua Value Enterprise (RAVE)
enterprises.description: Rivers Aqua Value Enterprise (RAVE) is an agribusiness focused on fish processing and value addition in Rivers State, Nigeria. We source fresh fish directly from local fish farmers and riverine fishing communities and transform them into premium, hygienically processed smoked fish using improved smoking technology and modern packaging techniques. Our products are designed to reduce post-harvest losses, extend shelf life, and meet the quality standards required by households, restaurants, supermarkets, hotels, and institutional buyers

enterprises.name: Riv Farm
enterprises.description: A mobile platform that connects fish farmers in Rivers State directly to consumers, restaurants, and retailers, eliminating middlemen. The problem is inefficient distribution, price inflation, and limited market access for farmers, which reduces profit and freshness of fish products. My solution is a logistics-enabled app that allows users to order fresh fish directly from farms with fast delivery, transparent pricing, and real-time availability.

enterprises.name: BlueHarvest AquaFarms Ltd
enterprises.description: We produce healthy and high quality fingerlings and juveniles of catfish and tilapia as farmers within and across Rivers State struggle with access to such. We're looking to fill that gap, increase yield, productivity and ensure sustainability.
